name: askfloat
signatures: askfloat(title, prompt, *, initialvalue=None, minvalue=None, maxvalue=None, parent=None)
doc: Prompt the user to enter a value of the desired type and return it, or None if the dialog is cancelled.

name: askinteger
signatures: askinteger(title, prompt, *, initialvalue=None, minvalue=None, maxvalue=None, parent=None)
doc: Prompt the user to enter a value of the desired type and return it, or None if the dialog is cancelled.

name: askstring
doc: Prompt the user to enter a value of the desired type and return it, or None if the dialog is cancelled.

name: Dialog
doc: The base class for custom dialogs. Instantiating it shows the dialog modally and returns once the user closes it; the entered value is then available in the result attribute.

name: apply
doc: Process the data entered by the user, for example by storing it in the result attribute. Called after validate() succeeds and just before the dialog is destroyed. The default implementation does nothing; override it to act on or store the result.

name: body
doc: Override to construct the dialog’s interface and return the widget that should have initial focus.

name: buttonbox
doc: Default behaviour adds OK and Cancel buttons. Override for custom button layouts.

name: destroy
doc: Destroy the dialog window, clearing the reference to the widget that had the initial focus.

name: result
doc: The value produced by apply(), or None if the dialog was cancelled.

name: validate
doc: Validate the data entered by the user. Return true if it is valid, in which case the dialog proceeds to apply(); return false to keep the dialog open. The default implementation always returns true; override it to check the input.

name: SimpleDialog
signatures: SimpleDialog(master, text='', buttons=[], default=None, cancel=None, title=None, class_=None)
doc: A simple modal dialog that displays the message text above a row of push buttons whose labels are given by buttons, and returns the index of the button the user presses. default is the index of the button activated by the Return key, cancel the index returned when the window is closed through the window manager, title the window title, and class_ the Tk class name of the window.

name: go
doc: Display the dialog, wait until the user presses a button or closes the window, and return the index of the chosen button.
